name: _validate_compressed_sparse_indices
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim from the supplied registered schema: aten::_validate_compressed_sparse_indices(bool is_crow, Tensor compressed_idx, Tensor plain_idx, int cdim, int dim, int nnz) -> (). This single registered overload is the only supplied signature; it is representative and NOT exclusive. Original Gems pytest owns the full contract: overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation behavior all remain defined by tests/test__validate_compressed_sparse_indices.py, which must never be narrowed or removed to fit this one signature. Semantics (from the tests): validates a compressed sparse index descriptor and returns None. compressed_idx has shape batch + (cdim + 1,) and holds one offset per compressed row/slice plus the terminal offset nnz; plain_idx has shape batch + (nnz,) and holds plain indices inside [0, dim). is_crow is a mandatory bool flag that the suite exercises in both directions (True and False) over the same two descriptors, each case being compared against the ATen reference; the tests assert no specific layout direction for it. cdim, dim and nnz are mandatory Python ints with no schema default and the two descriptors must have matching shapes with no broadcasting. The suite covers valid descriptors (is_crow True and False, int32 indices plus int64 where flag_gems.runtime.device.support_int64 holds, rank-dispatch shapes up to rank 9, empty batch, zero cdim/nnz, dim 0 and dim 1, the 32-bit dim limit of 2**31 - 1, and the dim = 2**31 limit where int64 is supported) plus safe host/schema errors (negative or mismatched cdim/nnz, rank-0 descriptors, dim above INT32_MAX for an int32 kernel, and, on the nvidia vendor only, unsupported non-integer index dtypes). Index-content error workloads are deliberately pending in the local protocol-gap record because the CUDA_KERNEL_ASSERT path aborts the process; they remain pytest's responsibility, not this definition's. Registered schema strings supplied (verbatim): aten::_validate_compressed_sparse_indices(bool is_crow, Tensor compressed_idx, Tensor plain_idx, int cdim, int dim, int nnz) -> ().
